## pit built-ins that aren't available on pi-durable hosts

These throw `PitDurableUnavailableError`:

| Built-in | Reason pit gives |
|---|---|
| `workspace.viewImage` | no image reader (above) |
| `session.getName` | "pi-durable conversations have no name" |
| `session.setName` | same |
| `session.compact` | "the host compacts the conversation" |
| `commands.list` (all of `commands.*`) | "the host has no slash commands" |
| `models.set` | "the host configures the conversation's model" |
| `models.listOfType` | falls through to an unavailable error |
|
